schema_documentation:
One key-set of 13 flat top-level keys for all 3,889 records (stats json).
- `text` — str, 100%, nonempty 100%. The rendered document. 448–87,426 chars, mean 7,433.5, sum_len 28,908,977.
- `title` — str, 100%. official_title (falls back to data.title.el), 12–547 chars, mean 83.2. Already the first line of `text`.
- `org_owner` — str, 100%, nonempty 99.72%. Owning ministry/agency, 0–76 chars.
- `life_events` — str, 100%, nonempty 99.05%. `; `-joined life-event tags, 0–202 chars.
- `mitos_id` — str, 100%, fixed 6 chars. `uuid` — str, 100%, fixed 36. `url` — str, 100%, fixed 30. `ns` — str, 100%, always "ΔΔ". `last_updated` — str, 100%, ISO-8601, fixed 25 chars.
- `n_conditions`, `n_steps`, `n_evidences`, `n_rules` — int, 100% each. Item counts of the source arrays.
Synthetic Greek section headers inside `text` (my count of records containing each): `Νομικό πλαίσιο:` 3,874, `Βήματα:` 3,707, `Προϋποθέσεις:` 3,524, `Τρόπος υποβολής:` 3,458, `Δικαιολογητικά:` 3,026, `Σημειώσεις SDG:` 1,656.
